page_title: LEV 3-2 ELC | Levante v Elche 23/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' Eder Sarabia (Elche) picks up a yellow card for unsporting behaviour after the half-time whistle. He should have gone straight into the dressing room instead.
90+9' That's the end of the match.
90+6' 3 - 2 Gooal! Jon Ander Olasagasti takes over corner duties. Alan Matturro (Levante) gets his head on the ball from the corner and puts it into the bottom left corner. 3:2.
90+5' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Levante.
90+4' Pablo Martinez Andres (Levante) is about to take a corner kick.
90+2' 2 - 2 What a GOAL! Adam Boayar (Elche) connects perfectly with the ball in the box to score with a wonderful scissor kick. It’s now 2:2.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.

89' Josan (Elche) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition. The ball goes out of play and Levante will have a goal kick.
87' Josan (Elche) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Levante.
85' Substitution. Marc Aguado did his best and is replaced by Alex Sanchez (Elche).
84' Jose Munuera shows a yellow card to Ivan Romero (Levante), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
83' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 5:2.
81' Carlos Espi (Levante) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his effort towards the middle of the goal is comfortably saved by the goalkeeper.
80' Levante have a corner.
80' Pablo Martinez Andres (Levante) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat. Levante have a corner.
78' Jeremy Toljan (Levante) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
75' The attendance is 18973.
74' Here comes a substitution. Carlos Alvarez is given a rest as he is replaced by Jon Ander Olasagasti (Levante).
74' Luis Castro has decided to make a change. Carlos Espi (Levante) replaces Karl Etta Eyong.
71' A yellow card for a tackle by Andre Silva (Elche). Jose Munuera doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
70' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Rodrigo Mendoza (Elche) is coming onto the pitch as Grady Diangana cannot continue after picking up an injury.
70' Eder Sarabia decides to make a substitution. Alvaro Rodriguez will be replaced by Andre Silva (Elche).
70' Substitution. Yago Santiago will be replaced by Adam Boayar (Elche).
68' 2 - 1 Perfectly taken free kick! Pablo Martinez Andres sends the ball in, Dela (Levante) manages to jump highest near the penalty spot and plants a cracking header inside the left post. It's 2:1.
67' Aleix Febas (Elche) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
67' Jose Munuera shows the yellow card to Aleix Febas (Elche) for a heavy challenge.
66' Ivan Romero (Levante) finds his way to a rebound inside the six-yard box thanks to his strength and unleashes a strike towards goal, but it ricochets away off one of his teammates.
66' Karl Etta Eyong (Levante) gets on the end of a defence splitting pass inside the box and immediately directs a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the Inaki Pena makes a great save.
65' Jeremy Toljan (Levante) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
64' Paco Cortes (Levante) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
62' Substitution. Martim Neto makes way for Josan (Elche).
61' Good movement by Martim Neto (Elche), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Levante.
59' Ivan Romero (Levante) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
58' Dela (Levante) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
57' A big rebound finds it way to Dela (Levante), whose attempted long-range shot is almost immediately blocked by one of the opposition players.
56' Leo Petrot (Elche) fouls his opponent and receives a yellow card from the referee, but he is clearly not happy with the decision.
55' Carlos Alvarez (Levante) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
55' Paco Cortes (Levante) commits a rough challenge and Jose Munuera blows his whistle for a foul.

53' Leo Petrot (Elche) finds himself some space around the penalty spot to connect with a fine free kick. His header is slightly mistimed and sails inches over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Levante.

52' The game is interrupted. Alan Matturro (Levante) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did. Elche have a free kick.
50' 1 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Jeremy Toljan plays it into the box, and Pablo Martinez Andres (Levante) gets on the end of the cross to put it low into the middle of the net. 1:1.
48' Good defending. Pablo Martinez Andres (Levante) tries to find Paco Cortes inside the box, but the pass is cut out.

35' The resulting corner from Marc Aguado (Elche) comes to nothing.

30' Ivan Romero (Levante) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
29' Alvaro Rodriguez (Elche) is penalised for a foul. Jose Munuera had a clear view and blows his whistle.
28' Carlos Alvarez (Levante) bangs the ball towards goal from the edge of the box, but it's rising all the way and sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Elche will have a goal kick.
27' Jeremy Toljan (Levante) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
25' Jeremy Toljan (Levante) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
23' The free kick is delivered by Martim Neto (Elche) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
22' Jeremy Toljan (Levante) commits a rough challenge and Jose Munuera blows his whistle for an infringement. Elche are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
21' German Valera (Elche) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Jose Munuera blows for a foul.
19' Pablo Martinez Andres (Levante) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
17' The linesman signals that Carlos Alvarez (Levante) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.

14' Ivan Romero (Levante) produces a header from inside the penalty area, but he doesn't manage to hit the ball properly and it flies well over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Elche will have a goal kick.
13' Levante will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
12' Levante have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender. Levante get a corner.
11' 0 - 1 Goal! Alvaro Rodriguez (Elche) pounced on a loose ball inside the penalty area and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom right corner. He makes it 0:1.
10' The corner is swung in but Levante can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
9' The resulting set piece from Levante is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players. Levante force a corner. They send men into the box.
8' Karl Etta Eyong (Levante) blasts the ball high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Elche will have a goal kick.
5' Ivan Romero (Levante) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.

4' Grady Diangana (Elche) bends the ball in from the edge of the box which worries the keeper, but it eventually sails just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Levante.
